name: robot_action
description: Execute one atomic robot action. Call once per action, in execution order. Omit slot fields that the command does not mention.

intent.description: MOVE go to a place; CLEAN vacuum/mop a place; PLAY play an sdcard file; SHOW display a message; GET pick up an object; GIVE hand an object to someone; STOP halt everything; WAIT pause for a duration; WAKEUP go wake a person; UNAVAILABLE command not understood or not doable

location.description: place: kitchen, my room, here, garage, where I cook

object.description: physical thing: cup, red ball, the plant

recipient.description: person receiving or being woken: John, my wife, the kids

duration_amount.description: how long to wait, numeric value
